briefTitle: A Study to Investigate ALE.P02 as a Monotherapy or in Combination With Pembrolizumab in Adult Patients With Selected CLDN1+ Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced locally recurrent and inoperable or metastatic SqNSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The stage is described as advanced, locally recurrent and inoperable or metastatic rather than a specific stage list, but is in scope.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Phase I Dose Escalation: Have received at least one systemic standard of care regimen and being refractory or intolerant to the treatment. Phase I Monotherapy RDE and Phase II: Have received no more than 2 lines of systemic standard of care regimen and being refractory or intolerant to the treatment. Phase I Combination Therapy RDE: Have received no previous systemic therapy in incurable recurrent or metastatic setting
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements differ depending on the study phase and cohort, preventing a single typed prior lines check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have provided tissue for CLDN1 analysis in a central laboratory.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: CLDN1 is not a standard typed biomarker kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have recovered from all toxicities led by prior treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective judgment regarding toxicity recovery.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1 as determined by the site.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received antineoplastic therapies prior to study intervention within specified time frame.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout time frame specifics are not detailed as a single simple cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has rapidly progressing disease (eg, tumor bleeding, uncontrolled tumor pain).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinical judgment regarding rapid progression, tumor bleeding, and pain.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with uncontrolled diabetes. Has clinically significant gastrointestinal bleeding and has an active infection requiring systemic treatment and has a history or current evidence of any condition, therapy, or laboratory abnormality that might confound the results of the clinical study, interfere with the patient's participation for the full duration of the clinical study, or is not in the best interest of the patient to participate. Concomitant use of drugs that are known to prolong or shorten QT and/or have known risk of Torsades de Pointes.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad investigator discretion and multiple general comorbidities and medications.
